root_cause_analysis.symptom: Two residual gaps from spec-20260506-092951: (a) §5.7 linter only catches ≥3-source duplicates, missing the 2-source class the §1 evidence named; (b) §5.6 named `_isAlternative` as dead code with deletion as an authorized option, but cycle-1 dev chose leave-as-is.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Parent spec §5.7 acceptance recipe used 'AND...AND...AND' wording, which produced a literal ≥3-source threshold in dev — even though §1 evidence was a 2-source case. Parent §5.6 explicitly authorized either deletion or leave-as-is for the dead code; cycle-1 chose the lower-effort option. User's 立刻完成所有可以满足我需求的 closes both residuals.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — design-by-spec residual, not a regression from a specific commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Parent spec author wrote the §5.7 recipe with 'AND...AND' to capture the strongest form of the bug; the §1 evidence was a weaker 2-source form that didn't match the recipe verbatim. §5.6 dead-code was authored as a low-priority optional cleanup.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: (a) A future regression that re-introduces a G5415-style 2-source cross-file duplicate would silently slip past the linter — exactly the class the §1 evidence named. (b) Dead code with 5 read sites in a 3376-line renderer is a maintenance hazard and a misleading signal for future maintainers (suggests a Plan-B-vs-Plan-C visual distinction that does not exist).
